what_changed: first generator signature (source hash + flags) in the GT cache key, so cached GT of an older generator (e.g. without the Holland Village / Queenstown road) is never reused
keyframe_gt 8x faster (big polygons cut to the grid window first); output bit-identical to v1 on 10 mini keyframes; the generator of the runs up to t2_ref
the standalone suite: radar-corrected velocity / flow in m/s, masks, one stationary rule; moving boxes at the ANNOTATION time
moving boxes at the CAMERA time (option boxes_at); superseded 18 minutes later by v5, no run was trained on it
review fixes (signature computed once at construction, world_ann is a copy); the generator of the t10 runs

review fixes of the generator: ego velocity no longer halved at the first and last keyframe of a sequence (the pose window is moved inside the poses), instance taken at the central sub-pixels like velocity (a cell with a velocity always names its box), flow_sigma divided by the covered share (edge cells keep the box sigma), flow_config.ego_half_window reaches the dense ego flow; the ego flow of v5 is wrong at the two ends of every sequence, so v5 GT is rebuilt, not mixed

sensor coverage of the front rig (D36 - D38): boxes hide with their real height, standing on the ground plane (the `occluded` layer is softer, the old rule was an infinitely high wall), new module coverage.py (camera / radar cells, hidden cells, the footprint share f), per box share_camera / share_radar / share_fusion and the nuScenes point counts, meta image_size and radar_poses; camera, radar and undefined are unchanged

v7 made fast, the same GT: the radar files of a keyframe are read in parallel, the map polygons and the centre-line points are made once, the observed shares of all boxes are computed in one pass, keyframe_gt is split into methods; 34 keyframes of four maps are bit-identical to v7 in every layer and meta entry; v7 was never built (a build of it was stopped at 1,455 keyframes), the trainval GT of this version is the first of the coverage versions

v8 made twice as fast, the same GT: the exact record-in-patch test of the map runs with the geometry of a record made once (the devkit rebuilt it on every call), inside_quad tests all four edges at once; every layer and meta entry of 211 frames of all ten mini sequences equals the v7 / v8 code byte for byte; the trainval store of v8 serves as its store (same bytes, hardlinked after a sample check)
